name: UGC 6934, host of SN 2003dg (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 6934, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2003dg-hubble
story: In 2003 a rare calcium-rich supernova, SN 2003dg, flared in this disk galaxy, in line with the dark lane of dust across its center.

claims.text: UGC 6934 is a spiral, classified SA(r)cd: sp; SN 2003dg was 2.7 arcsec E, 3.1 arcsec S of its nucleus at 11:57:31.97 -01:15:13.6 (matches the pointing)
SN 2003dg was discovered in 2003 by KAIT/LOTOSS
Program 13698 images the SN 2003dg site, which lies on its host's stellar disk
